description: This Java source file defines a JAX-RS ExceptionMapper for handling PlatformApiDataValidationException exceptions in the Fineract project. It maps such exceptions to HTTP 400 responses with a structured error response payload.

classes.name: PlatformApiDataValidationExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS ExceptionMapper that converts PlatformApiDataValidationException instances into HTTP responses with a structured error message.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a PlatformApiDataValidationException into an HTTP 400 Bad Request Response containing a global error response payload.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns an integer error code (2002) associated with the exception mapping.
